method: Fetched live during the GitHub Pages build. Weather, air and radar are refreshed in the browser. Municipal notices do not allow browser CORS, so they are this scrape plus a link to the live tracker.

electricity_national.decode: Eskom returns 1 for no load shedding. Stage = value − 1.
electricity_national.context: Eskom told SA News on 7 Sep 2026 it had gone about 476 days without load shedding and had completed winter 2026 without shedding. This build does not add days onto that count. Load reduction is a separate, local practice and was not finished: on 7 Sep, 7 provinces were free and about 1.22 million of 1.69 million targeted customers had been restored.

water_outages.title: Burst pipe — supply isolated
water_outages.detail: Unplanned interruption from a burst pipe at the corner of 14th Avenue and Florence Moposho Street. First reported Thu 24 Sep 2026 at 04:44. Johannesburg Water isolated the supply. Low pressure to no water. No restoration time was published in the notice this scrape read.
actions: If any pressure is left, fill containers now. Once the isolation is complete the tap will not recover by itself.
Drinking water is 5 litres per person per day. Washing and cooking need about 15 more.
Call Johannesburg Water on 0860 562 874 and ask for a reference number. Email a burst to fault@jwater.co.za if the line is busy.
A City Power planned shutdown that includes Alexandra is also on the board, scheduled to end Sunday 13:00. Charge phones while you still have power.
water_outages.via: OurPower reading the Johannesburg Water post, checked 24 Sep 2026

water_outages.title: Do not use tap water
water_outages.detail: Johannesburg Water issued a water-quality notice for Bezuidenhout Valley after network repairs. Residents were told not to use the water for household purposes. Tankers were the alternative supply. First reported Sun 20 Sep 2026 at 02:29. Last update read in this scrape: Tue 22 Sep 10:35, which said laboratory results were expected on the morning of 23 Sep. On 24 Sep the notice was still listed as active. Streets named: Albertina Sisulu Road, 10th Avenue, 7th Avenue. Alexander Park reservoir was on bypass, so pressure may also be poor.
actions: Do not drink, cook, brush teeth or mix baby formula from the tap until Johannesburg Water says the water is safe.
Boiling is not a workaround for this notice. The utility said not to use it for household purposes.
Use stored water or the tanker.
Call 0860 562 874 before you trust a neighbour's 'it's fine now'.
water_outages.via: OurPower reading the Johannesburg Water notice, still listed active 24 Sep 2026

water_rejected.why: The OurPower Johannesburg index listed Bryanston among areas affected on 24 Sep 2026, but the Bryanston suburb page fetched in the same hour said reservoirs were supplying normally and there was no current water outage. Not shown as an active outage.

power_outages.title: Power still out for part of Honeydew
power_outages.detail: Tree obstruction on overhead lines. City Power said about 80% of Honeydew and Honeypark customers were back by 15:21 on 24 Sep, with the team still on site for the rest. Ruimsig switching station was part of the job. If you are in the restored 80%, this card is stale for your house.
power_outages.via: OurPower timeline of City Power posts, 24 Sep 2026

power_outages.title: Parts of Fleurhof still being investigated
power_outages.detail: Operators were on site at 13:43 on 24 Sep investigating an outage in parts of Fleurhof. An earlier night update said dayshift would continue because of visibility. This is not a national load-shedding slot.

power_outages.title: Pennyville and Noordgesig — same-day posts disagree
power_outages.detail: A City Power post at 06:14 on 24 Sep said power was fully restored. A later active card still listed customers in Pennyville and Noordgesig as off after a trip. Treat your own lights as the fact. If they are off, call and get a reference. If they are on, the later card is the stale one.
power_outages.via: OurPower showing both the 06:14 restoration and a later active card
